name: [🔭TURRETS] Destruction Game
desc:
In the epic game called 💥Destruction Game you can experience cutting edge realistic breaking physics. Break stuff with your powerful weapons and bear no consequences! There is a ton of cool and unique weapons to unlock and use to destroy the big map.

👥💰 Rember to join our group (https://www.roblox.com/groups/6899370) to get 25% more bonks! 

❗ Just keep in mind the map resets every 15 minutes so you can have a fresh new map!

⚠️ Warning! This game causes intense server lag, keep in mind if more people are breaking stuff the game might slow down dramatically. 

📜 What's new:
• Brand new special Rocket Turrets weapon available for 16K bonks

Game inspired by Destruction Physics
